threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the ‘overground’ instead of just the ‘London Rail’ like the rest of us. Get ready for proper eye rolls!
Heard a guy on the N35 arguing with his mate about which chicken shop is the best. Must've been at least ten minutes of pure passion over fried chicken.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Standing at the kiosk on Warshauer Straße, I realized I was in a place where a random chef would share his homemade curry recipe with you over a cigarette.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a straight-up techno party in an old swimming pool. Club der Visionaere does it right with the summer vibes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they reference the ‘smell of the 24th St BART station’ like it’s a nostalgic scent rather than a warning.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 today, and a guy serenaded us with an accordion. Only in San Francisco do you get a personal concert while stuck in traffic.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are just for sipping sangria, but locals know they're the heartbeat of street music and pop-up art. Such a vibe!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by how they keep using 'metro' for 'tren' when heading to Sabadell. It’s a dead giveaway!

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think buying a coffee means waiting in line at the chains instead of finding the hidden gem around the corner.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded the driver with an improvised rap about missing his stop. Only in Brixton do you see that kind of late-night creativity.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids setting up a makeshift stage in the park, complete with a cardboard microphone and all, I thought, "Yep, this is home."

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you stumble upon a hidden courtyard hosting spontaneous techno raves. It's like a secret club, but without the door policy.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows that if you step on a Muni bus and it’s empty, that driver is about to go rogue with a detour.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tutu dancing on the bus today, totally unfazed by the delays. Just another Tuesday in the TL, I guess.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'poble' means just the village vibe. But here, it's the roots of our identity, not just quaint streets and tapas bars.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new when they still ask for 'tapas' at a pinchos bar, completely missing the point of ordering by skewer.
